entries.title: keep the personal copy locked when unlocking a work profile app
entries.description: Turning off a work profile app no longer also unlocks the personal copy of the same app.

entries.title: bump the compose group across 1 directory with 2 updates
entries.description: Bumps the compose group with 2 updates in the / directory: androidx.compose:compose-bom and androidx.compose.material3:material3.

entries.title: bump com.android.application in the agp group
entries.description: Bumps the agp group with 1 update: com.android.application.

entries.title: fix apps remaining locked after removal due to unkeyed package entries
keep an app unlocked when an overlay opens over it
entries.description: Locked apps no longer ask for authentication again after a share sheet, permission dialog or similar overlay appears on top of them.

entries.title: return work profile apps to their profile after auth
entries.description: Locked work profile apps no longer open as the personal copy after the resume prompt, and the MIUI face prompt now releases the front camera when it closes.

entries.title: fall back to device credential when biometrics lock out
entries.description: Locked apps no longer become unopenable after too many failed fingerprint or face attempts.

entries.title: show the unlock prompt for locked apps in a work profile
entries.description: Locked work profile apps no longer bounce straight back to the home screen when tapped.

entries.title: bump the compose group across 1 directory with 2 updates
bump actions/setup-java from 5 to 6 in the actions group
bump com.android.application from 9.3.1 to 9.3.2 in the agp group across 1 directory
use the solid prompt when a locked app is already on screen
entries.description: A locked app coming back from the recents screen is covered as soon as the prompt starts instead of staying readable behind it.

entries.title: lock apps reopened from the recents screen without a launch
entries.description: Locked apps no longer open without authentication when you return to them from the recents screen.

entries.title: drop the unused context parameter from usableAuthenticators
scope the Samsung sensor-class match to Samsung devices
add native OEM face unlock for Samsung and Xiaomi
entries.description: Locked apps can now be unlocked with the built-in face scanner on Samsung and Xiaomi devices, where the standard prompt does not offer it.

entries.title: re-issue a blocked screen pin once the app is unlocked
entries.description: Pinning a locked app from recents now pins it after the unlock prompt is passed, instead of opening the app unpinned.
